Get the following errors when clicking file - export - three.js then click export button.

I got the 3d model from blendswap to just play with.  Then when I exported, it failed. 

I have went through the steps necessary when adding the addon to Blender and it shows up under my export options - which makes me believe it was added correctly.  The steps to adding it were downloading the project, then selecting the correct folder and copying and pasting it to the correct folder under blender.

Also, thank you @WestLangley  for commenting. Sorry I didn't not provide sufficient information.  I know I followed the correct steps, however, still when clicking on the export three js option and then clicking "export" it brings that black screen with errors up.
It would be helpful if you specified the model you're using so we can reproduce the issue.

I'm using blender 2.62.0 on Ubuntu 12.04.3 LTS (64bits), I got the same error.

steps to reproduce:
1. open blender from terminal using `blender`
2. on the default new file, select the cube
3. File > Export > three.js
4. Export file
5. Error shows up.

here's the full stack trace:


@CoDEmanX @brycefisher @joostfaassen @anka-sirota does any of you guys have some bandwidth to take a look at this?
